scope: PNG Tennis Association constitution adopted in 2001, documenting national development, club coordination, ranking, tournament and team-selection functions.
limitations: Formal governance mandate is evidence of federation capacity from 2001 and is not backcast.

observations.text_value: The association's 2001 constitution mandates public tennis development, coordination of member clubs, player rankings, national/international tournaments and team selection.
observations.definition_notes: Structural/context evidence; the observed fact is not itself a direct annual 1–10 rating.
